name: Fireball
summary: A streak of flame that bursts into a fiery explosion, scorching every creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere.

m.text: a ball of bat guano and sulfur

stats.effect:
A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {ref:glossary/sphere} centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.
